newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet off as report stirs merger worries.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet off as report stirs merger worries.

text.p: Shares in British hotel and restaurant group Grand Metropolitan Plc sank on Tuesday after a press report said the group faced a new legal challenge, dealers said.
By 0745 GMT, the shares were down 10-1/2p to 604.

The Independent newspaper said Brent Walker Group Plc was considering a new legal challenge to GrandMet over a dispute concerning betting chain William Hill. The row dates from the acquisition by Brent Walker of William Hill from GrandMet in 1989.
The newspaper said that if the action goes ahead, GrandMet could face a legal claim of 100 million stg, posing new uncertainties about its planned 24 billion stg merger with Guinness Plc.
"I don't know if (a suit) like this could really stop the merger from going through, but any story that raises new uncertainties is going to hurt," said one marketmaker.
Shares in Guinness fell 11p to 603. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
